plainText:
Samantha Moon is a voice actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Little is known about Moon's life, other than she became a voice actress as an adult. She joined the during , where she voiced several minor characters. She gained her most notable role during where she voiced Officer Jenny. Moon eventually left the series with her role of Officer Jenny going to Martha Harms.

==Pokémon roles==
===Animation===
==== ====
Officer Jenny (SM009-SM039)
Elma
Female Doctor (XY112)
Lilia

==Other non-Pokémon roles==
